gloss: real image; true picture; actual figure

definitions.explanation: In optics, an image formed by converging light rays that can be projected onto a screen. The opposite of a virtual image.

definitions.gloss: true picture; actual figure; real portrait
definitions.explanation: The true, unembellished reality of a person, organization, or situation — as opposed to an idealized or media-constructed image.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧ (real, actual) and ⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (image, figure). The two senses correspond to the literal (optics) and figurative (true nature) meanings of "real image."

The optics sense (sense 1) is standard physics vocabulary taught in middle school. The figurative sense (sense 2) is common in journalism, biography, and cultural criticism — typically paired with verbs like ⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧ (to approach), ⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧ (to depict), or ⟦{明|あき}らかにする→明らかにする：22256_akirakanisuru⟧ (to reveal).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実像|じつぞう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{虚像|きょぞう}→虚像：17791_kyozou⟧: real image and virtual image (optics); reality and façade (figurative)
- {実像|じつぞう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧: to get to the truth of
- {実像|じつぞう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to depict the true picture
- {凸|とつ}⟦レンズ→レンズ：07808_renzu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実像|じつぞう}: real image from a convex lens

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{虚像|きょぞう}→虚像：17791_kyozou⟧: virtual image — the opposite in both optics and figurative use
- ⟦{実態|じったい}→実態：10567_jittai⟧: actual state; true condition — similar figurative meaning but more concrete and data-oriented
- ⟦{素顔|すがお}→素顔：13802_sugao⟧: true face; unmasked self — more personal, about an individual's genuine character
